title.narrative: Strengthening of the emergency response to HIV, tuberculosis and malaria in key transit points along the migration route in Central America - Central America - Multicountry Americas IOM (01-Jun-2025-31-May-2026)

description.narrative: Multicountry Americas IOM, Multicomponent, International Organization for Migration (IOM)This program has the following goals: To support procurement and distribution of HIV, TB and malaria essential commodities and the provision of prevention, testing and treatment services for migrants along migratory routes in Central America (Panama, Costa Rica and Guatemala) and vulnerable host community members.. The objectives of this program are: Ensure health assistance actively contributes to meeting the immediate and longer-term needs of affected populations.. Migration flows and cross-border mobility are well managed, with measures to ensure well-being, including health, security and safety throughout the mobility continuum.
